diagnosis: The throttle class constructs its cache key from a client-supplied tenant_id in query parameters or request body rather than from request.user.tenant. An authenticated attacker can submit a victim tenant's ID in rapid bursts, prematurely triggering rate limiting and causing a denial of service against the victim tenant.
exploit_request:
GET /api/search/?tenant_id=902&q=status HTTP/1.1
Host: platform.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
